goal: Accept valid 65-byte Taproot SIGHASH_ALL signatures when the sighash type is unset in a PSBT
Prevents multi-party Taproot transactions from failing to be signed further or finalized
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: risk of bugs from conflating sighash types, no author reply (achow101)

Approach support because SIGHASH_ALL commits to the same digest as SIGHASH_DEFAULT (Husteem)
